recipe_name: Pasta with smoked salmon, goat cheese and spinach
X-image-attribution: JIP, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.step: Boil water with a bit of salt
Heat a bit of olive oil in a pan and cook 3/4ths of the spinach
Peal the garlic and cut ti finely. Add the pulp to the spinach and season with pepper and salt.
Add the cookedstewed spinach to a blender or cutter with a bit of water. Add the ricotta and goat cheese. Blend until smooth.
Boil the spaghetti in the water
Heat some olive oil in a pan
Peal the onion and cut it into strips. Cook it in the oil
Add the pine nuts and let it roast for a moment
Add the pasta to the onions and pine pits.
Add the sauce to the spaghetti together with a bit of the spaghetti water. Add the rest of the spinach leaves. Mix everything.
Rip the salmon into pieces. Add to the pasta when serving.
